name: The All-Seeing Eye of Zuldazar
label: Quest
description: The All-Seeing Eye of Zuldazar: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: If only we had ten-thousand more like you, friend. The armies of Hakkar would be scattered to the wind in the blink of an eye.
Alas, the Eye is ready to realize its full potential. Give it to me.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Smite them all and let Hakkar sort them out...
